concerns.text: FR-014 states the system MUST validate the detected sentiment drift against an external economic event timeline to ensure scientific validity, but provides no measurable or observable criterion (e.g., alignment metric, threshold, or test procedure). Without a concrete validation rule the requirement cannot be deterministically verified.

SC-006 describes methodological validity as a “negligible absolute difference” after masking [deferred] to [deferred] of data, but the proportion of data to mask and the acceptable difference threshold are left as placeholders. This makes the success criterion unmeasurable; a test cannot determine pass/fail without concrete values.
